title: Book One · Chapter 168: A Table that Moves
story:
Miss Wu presses one corner of the long table. It moves under her hand. It is not falling apart. One foot does not quite meet the floor.

Leo presses the other corner. The first corner rises a little. Ronan puts the room plan down and asks him to stop. The table rocks when they touch it. The game cards may slide off during the afternoon.

“Leave the table here,” Miss Wu tells them. One adult looks after the school rooms. Miss Wu asks him to check the table. While they wait, the children move the loose papers. They put them on another desk.

Ronan wants to fetch Dad. Then he remembers that Dad is at work. This table belongs to the school, not their kitchen. The school has its own people for a school table.

The man comes after lunch. He checks the feet of the table. Then he looks at the floor beneath them. Another adult helps him move the table. Then he checks it again. The new place is firm. The children stand back and watch. The adults will do the work with the tools.

The move is small, but now the game end is closer to the window. Mei checks the sun. Her shaded wall is still fine. Ronan walks through the route. He can walk past the table easily. He does not hit its edge.

Leo lays out the cards. They stay flat. He puts the empty pencil box near the cards. Could visitors reach it there? He tries with one hand. Ronan moves it back before it can sit too close to the edge.

“That goes in the middle with Mr Qiu's story,” he says.

“I know. I was trying.”

Ronan nods. Leo is testing the place for the box. He has not said they must change the plan. Ronan lets him finish looking.

They put everything away again. There is no real display yet. The room still has lessons and ordinary school use before Saturday. Miss Wu locks the cupboard but leaves the room open. Other classes still use it. Final setup will be on Saturday, before visitors arrive.

Ronan writes the table's new place on the current plan. He crosses out the old one with a single clear line. They can still read the old place on the plan. The old place and new place are both on it.

At home he tells Dad the table story. “Did someone check it in the new place?” Dad asks. Ronan says yes. He describes his walk through the room. He tells Dad the cards stayed still too.

“Then you checked the route. Good,” Dad says.

Ronan sits on the repaired stool. Its legs are firm beneath him. He sits safely on it. Dad fixed their kitchen stool. The school adults checked the long table. Other people can help with the room too. The other adults can do some of the work.

After supper he takes the ball outside. Mr Qiu is closing the side door. “Is Saturday still two until four?” he asks. Ronan says yes and shows him the clean notice.

The old man reads it once. He does not need ten copies. He puts the notice in his pocket. Do the children still need his pad? He asks Ronan. Ronan says they do. They agree on a place for the pad. Now Mr Qiu is bringing the pad himself. Ronan checks that on the list when he gets inside. They have one less question to ask.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：rocks＝摇晃；firm＝稳固；final setup＝最后布置。

情节提示：route＝行走路线；cupboard＝柜子；pad＝便笺本。

理解：1. 谁处理了学校桌子的摇晃问题？2. 为什么这一天仍不算正式布展完成？
